ryan: Hey team — getting multiple reports of 503 spikes for hosted inference starting ~08:12 UTC. Customers A and C hit timeouts. Alert fired on error-rate > 5% :eyes:

support-agent-maria: I pushed the CS emails. Customers saying: sudden 503s on text-generation endpoint, no auth errors, retries fail.

observability-bot: Alert: endpoint /v1/generate error_rate 8.4% over 10m. p95 latency increased from 120ms -> 650ms. Affected model: rwd-7b-v1.

infra-oncall-josh: I'm pulling worker logs and host metrics now. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: deploy rwd-7b-v1 -> production completed 07:55 UTC (canary OK). No rollback.

alice: grabbing docker logs from runner-7b-23: ```
[2026-03-17T08:11:30Z] infer-runner[pid=4123] WARNING: kv_prefetch: high memory growth
[2026-03-17T08:12:05Z] infer-runner[pid=4123] ERROR: segfault at 0x0 (signal 11)
[2026-03-17T08:12:06Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4123 (infer-runner) total-vm:1310720kB, anon-rss:980000kB
[2026-03-17T08:12:07Z] systemd: infer-runner.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
```

sam: That looks like an OOM then a SIGKILL from the OOM killer, but journal shows segfault as well. Could be memory corruption then OOM or vice versa.

ryan: Are the restarts causing queue backups at the gateway?

alice: Yes — routing backlog: router logs show 503s with upstream reset from 127.0.0.1: inbound connection closed. Example: `upstream: connection reset by peer` repeated ~30/sec.

infra-oncall-josh: Host metrics: GPU mem usage hit 100% on runner-7b-23 prior to crash. CPU fine. Swap used heavily, then kernel OOM. I suspect a KV prefetch regression that expanded cache for very long contexts.

support-agent-maria: Which customers are affected? I'm triaging priority cases.

ryan: Customers: A (prod traffic), C (staging heavy), D (small). Notified A that we are investigating.

alice: Quick repro steps I just ran on a dev instance: sending a single request with a ~180k token synthetic prompt (cut-and-paste loop) causes memory climb within 30s and then OOM. Script: ```bash
# repro
python stress_prompt.py --model rwd-7b-v1 --tokens 180000 --repeat 5
```

sam: Important: this only reproduces when `kv_prefetch=true` and `prefetch_window` > 64k. Default prefetch lower hasn't triggered OOM. Looks like a recent change to prefetch behavior in the runtime.

infra-oncall-josh: Rolling a temp mitigation: disable kv_prefetch on hosts serving rwd-7b-v1 and reduce `prefetch_window` to 16k via config override. Applying now to pool: hosted-prod-g7.

observability-bot: Config change applied to 6/12 hosts in hosted-prod-g7 at 08:28 UTC.

alice: After disabling prefetch, crash rate dropped back to baseline within 2 mins and error rate down to 0.9%. Customer A reporting fewer errors.

ryan: Good. What's the next root cause plan?

sam: Repro confirmed. Need a full bisect of recent runtime commits touching kv prefetch and buffer sizing (last 3 PRs). Also add a guard to reject requests with extremely large prompt sizes for rwd-7b-v1 at the gateway (short-term).

infra-oncall-josh: I'll snapshot the failing host and collect coredump/heap profile. Can we enable core dumps for the runner service (temp) and upload to S3?

alice: Doing `echo /tmp/cores/core.%e.%p > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern` and `ulimit -c unlimited` in runner unit. Starting capture now.

support-agent-maria: I'll keep customers updated: ETA for full fix?

ryan: Plan: (1) Mitigation applied (done) (2) Collect dumps & bisect (sam/josh) (3) Patch runtime (sam) (4) Deploy validated patch + enable prefetch with conservative window (alice). Aim for next 24-48h.

sam: One more thing — add a runtime guard to fail fast with 413-like response when prompt tokens exceed safe_thres for model variant. I'll open a PR and link.

ryan: Thanks all. @support-agent-maria keep pushing customer comms; tag infra-oncall-josh for any SLA or capacity questions. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: Summary: root cause suspected kv_prefetch memory expansion regression -> OOM -> infer-runner termination -> upstream resets -> 503 spike. Mitigation: disabled kv_prefetch + reduced prefetch_window. Followups: bisect, core dumps, runtime guard, prompt-size rejection.

support-agent-maria: Noted. I'll file the incident ticket and include repro steps + timeline.

alice: Uploading collected logs + heap snapshot to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/3637774444/ now.

infra-oncall-josh: I'll keep this thread updated with bisect progress.

ryan: Closing handoff — if error rate spikes again re-open pager. Thanks everyone. :pray:
